stages.name: PROFILE
stages.inputs: Search history, legacy issues/reservations and recommendation feedback; not tenant lending/reading-list/AI selection

browser_checks.scenario: Clean user global cold start uses explicitly labelled Popular fallback
Empty Patron library uses labelled global discovery
Clean user populated tenant cold start switches to canonical local acquisitions
Cold global Popular fallback View All keeps Popular provider
browser_checks.test_method: Browser response fixture reproduces clean-account empty recommendations, real Core popular results

personalization_inputs.candidate_query: Up to 10 recent search-history queries selected by recency weight (50 queried from Mongo); seed mode uses explicit book metadata.
personalization_inputs.profile: Legacy global issues/reservations and recommendation_feedbacks, with authors/subjects and active-work exclusions.
personalization_inputs.scoring: Semantic HNSW similarity 0.40, subject 0.15, author 0.10, borrowing 0.15, reservation 0.10, aggregate rating 0.05, popularity 0.03, availability 0.02; additive feedback adjustment 0.10. Existing diversity limits preserved.
personalization_inputs.ratings_note: Aggregate catalogue rating affects score; feedback types include RATED if such an existing system event is present. No direct user ratings-collection read is implemented here.

limits: Tenant local-only acquisitions are safe deterministic discovery, not a newly trained tenant personalization model.
No history queries means no ordinary semantic candidates, even if some other preference fields exist; the accepted UI cold fallback handles this.

Global profile updates do not invalidate a frozen ranking pool immediately; accepted 180-second/session/generation policy remains. Controlled quality case used a fresh login after the genuine Search interaction.
